segments.name: expense management software
segments.description: A single cloud-based expense management platform serving employees and businesses of all sizes, from freelancers to large enterprises.
segments.evidence: Expensify is a leading cloud-based expense management software platform that helps the smallest to the largest businesses simplify the way they manage money.

revenueModel.text: Companies and their employees pay a subscription for access to every feature of the platform, from expense management to bill payment.
revenueModel.evidence: Expensify is one platform, with one price that unlocks access to every feature on the platform, from expense management to bill payment.
